senses.gloss: श्वघ्निन् śva-ghn-ín, m. dice-player, professional 🞄gambler (V.).

स्वञ्च् su‿áñc, a. (going well), nimble (steed;
 🞄RV.).
श्वदृति śva-dṛti, m. dogʼs bladder.
श्वन् 1. śván, m. dog, f. शुनी śun-ī́, bitch.
श्वन् 2. śvan, —˚ in some cpds. (mātarí-śvan, etc.).
श्वभ्रीय śvabhr-īya, den. P. regard as a hole 🞄or pit.
श्वमांस śva-māṃsa, n. dogʼs flesh.
श्वयथु śvay-athu, m. [√ śvi] swelling.
श्वशुर śvá-śura, m. [by assimilation for 🞄original sva-śura] father-in-law: du. & pl. 🞄parent-in-law (pl. sts. for sg.): -ka, m. dear 🞄or poor father-in-law.
श्वाशुर śvāśura, a. (ī) belonging to oneʼs 🞄father-in-law.
श्वशुर्य śvaśur-ya, m. brother of husband or 🞄wife, brother-in-law.
श्वाशुर्य śvāśurya, incorr. for śvaśurya.

श्वश्रू śvaśrū́, f. [of śvaśura] mother-in-law: 🞄-śvaśurāḥ, pl. parents-in-law;
 -snuṣe, f. 🞄du. mother-in-law and daughter-in-law.

श्वस् śvás, ad. to-morrow, on the following 🞄day: śváḥ śvaḥ, day by day (V.);
 śvó bhūté, 🞄on the morrow (V.).
श्वसथ śvas-átha, m. panting (V.).
श्वसित śvas-ita, pp. n. breathing, breath 🞄(sts. pl.).
स्वसित su‿asita, a. beautifully black.

श्वस्तन śvás-tana, a. relating to the morrow: 🞄e'hani, on the morrow;
 ī, f. the suffix -tṛ 🞄as characteristic of the future, future tense.

श्वःसुत्या śvaḥ-sutyā, f. eve of the Sutyā 🞄rite: svargasya lokasya —, rite on the eve 🞄of the Soma celebration which leads to heaven;
 🞄-stotriya, m. Stotriya of the following day.
स्व 2. sva, E. for s-vas, we two are.

श्वाग्र śva‿agra, n. dogʼs tail;
 -ajina, n. dogʼs 🞄skin.
श्वान śvān-a, m. dog (= śvam): ī, f. bitch.

स्वन svan-á, m. roar (in V. of wind, water, 🞄fire, etc.);
 C.: sound (of every kind), crash 🞄(of thunder), rumbling (of a chariot), murmur 🞄(of a crowd), roar (of animals), tone (of 🞄musical instruments), song (of birds): -vat, 🞄a. sounding, resounding.
श्वान्त śvān-tá, old pp. tranquil (? RV.²).

श्वापद śvā-pada, m. n. beast of prey: -rājan, m. king of the beasts;
 -sevita, pp. infested 🞄by beasts of prey.

स्वपद sva-pada, n. oneʼs own (his etc.) place 🞄or abode;
 oneʼs own position or rank.
श्वाविध् śvā-vídh, m. (dog-piercing), porcupine.

स्वकीय sva-k-īya, a. own etc. (= 1. sva);
 m. 🞄pl. oneʼs people, friends: -tva, a. belonging 🞄or relation to oneself.
स्वग्नि su‿agní, a. having a good Agni or fire 🞄(RV.).
स्वग्राम sva-grāma, m. oneʼs own village.

स्वङ्ग sú‿aṅga, a. having a beautiful body, 🞄fair-limbed (RV.);
 -aṅguri, a. having beautiful 🞄or deft fingers (V.).

स्वाङ्ग sva‿aṅga, n. own member or body;
 🞄limb or body in the strict sense: -bhaṅga, 🞄m. injury to oneʼs own body.
स्वचेतस् sva-cetas, n. oneʼs own thought: 🞄in. -ā, out oneʼs own head.

स्वज् SVAJ, स्वञ्ज् SVAÑJ, Ⅰ. Ā. (P. 🞄metr.) svája, clasp, embrace. abhiṣvaja, id.. pari-ṣvaja, id.: pp. pariṣvakta, clasped, embraced;
 surrounded by 🞄(in., —˚).
स्वाद् SVĀD, v. स्वद् SVAD.

स्वधावत् svadhā́-vat, V. a. adhering to law, 🞄regular, constant, faithful (gnly. of Agni and 🞄Indra);
 (ā) -van, a. id. (V.).
स्वधिति svádhiti, f. axe, (butcherʼs) knife 🞄(V., very rarely P.).
स्वधृति svá-dhṛti, f. standing still of oneself 🞄(V.).

स्वध्वर su‿adhvará, a. performing the sacrifice 🞄well, adapted to the rite (RV.);
 n. good 🞄sacrifice (RV.).

स्वपन svap-aná, a. (V.) sleepy;
 n. sleeping, 🞄sleep (C.).

स्वापन svāp-ana, a. [cs. √ svap] causing 🞄or lulling to sleep;
 -aya, cs. √ svap.
स्वपरप्रतारक sva-para-pratāraka, a. deceiving 🞄oneself and others.
स्वपराह्णे su‿aparāhṇe, lc. late in the afternoon, 🞄towards evening (V.).

स्वपस् su‿ápas, a. doing good work, industrious, 🞄artistic (V.);
 m. artificer (RV.).
स्वपस्य su‿apas-yá, Ā. work well, be active.
स्वपस्या svapas-yā́, f. diligence, activity, 🞄skill (RV.).
स्वपितृ 1. svap-i-tṛ, m. sleeper.
स्वपितृ 2. sva-pitṛ, m. oneʼs own father.
स्वपिवात su‿api-vāta, a. [√ vat] understanding 🞄well (RV.¹).
स्वपुर sva-pura, n. oneʼs own city.
स्वपू sva-pū́, f. [√ pū] broom (RV.¹).
स्वप्नज् svapnaj, a. (nm. k) addicted to sleep, 🞄sleepy.
स्वप्नस् su‿ápnas, a. wealthy (RV.).
स्वप्नस्थान svapna-sthāna, n. sleeping, apartment.

स्वप्नाय svapnā-ya, den. Ā. with to sleep, 🞄be sleepy;
 resemble a dream.

स्वभिष्टि su‿abhiṣṭí, a. (RV.) helpful, favourable;
 🞄well-aided.

स्वाभू su‿ābhū́, a. (RV.) existing in abundance, 🞄ready to hand;
 ready to help.
स्वयत्न sva-yatna, m. own exertion.

स्वयम् sva-y-ám, indecl. oneself (himself, 🞄[] 🞄etc.);
 of oneself, of oneʼs own accord: in C. 🞄agreeing in sense with a nm. (as subject or 🞄predicate), with an in. (as logical subject), 🞄or with a g. (sts. also an ac., or a lc.).

स्वर् 2. SVAR, Ⅰ. P. svara (V., very rare), 🞄shine;
 cs. svaráya, P. id..

स्वरंकृत sú‿araṃkṛta pp. well-prepared 🞄(sacrifice;
 RV.¹).

स्वरु sváru, m. (V.) stake, sacrificial post;
 🞄splinter of the sacrificial post (rit.).
स्वर्क su‿arká, a. singing beautifully (V.).

स्वर्गत svar-gata, pp. gone to or being in 🞄heaven;
 dead.

स्वर्गति svar-gati, f. going to heaven;
 death.

स्वर्गामिन् svar-gāmin, a. going or having 🞄gone to heaven;
 dying, dead.

स्वर्गारोहण svarga‿ārohaṇa, n. ascension (to 🞄heaven);
 -argala, m. or n. bar to (the gate 🞄of) heaven.

स्वर्गौकस् svarga‿okas, m. dweller in heaven, 🞄god;
 one of the Blest.

स्वर्जित् svar-jit, a. winning light or heaven 🞄(V.);
 m. kind of sacrifice (C.).
स्वर्णदी svar-ṇadī, f. celestial river, Ganges.
स्वर्णर svâr-ṇara, m. lord of splendour, ep. 🞄of Agni, of the Sun, and of Soma (V.).
स्वर्थ su‿ártha, a. travelling to fair goals, 🞄directed to worthy ends (RV.).
स्वलक्षण sva-lakṣaṇa, a. having its own 🞄specific characteristics.
स्वलंकृत su‿alaṃkṛta, pp. well adorned.
स्वल्पीभू svalpī-bhū, grow small, melt away 🞄(merit): pp. nearly exhausted.
स्वल्पीयस् sval-p-īyas, cpv. very little (property).
स्ववंश्य sva-vaṃśya, a. belonging to oneʼs 🞄family.
स्ववग्रह su‿avagraha, a. easy to restrain or 🞄guide.
स्ववश 1. sva-vaśa, a. having control of oneself, 🞄independent, free: -tā, f. independence, 🞄freedom.

स्ववश 2. su‿avaśa, a. altogether without self-control;
 🞄-àvas, a. granting good protection, 🞄helpful (RV.).
स्वसृ svásṛ, f. sister (also fig. of closely connected 🞄feminine objects).
स्वसृत् sva-sṛ́-t, a. going oneʼs own way 🞄(RV.).
स्वसृत्व svasṛ-tvá, n. sistership.
स्वस्त्य svast-ya, a. [svasti] happy, prosperous.

स्वस्त्ययन svasti‿áyana, n. sg. pl. auspicious 🞄progress, success, good luck;
 blessing, benediction, 🞄congratulation: ac. w. vācaya, ask 🞄for a blessing.
स्वस्थीभू svasthī-bhū, return to oneʼs natural 🞄condition, become sober.
स्वस्रीय svasr-ī́ya, m. sisterʼs son, nephew: 🞄ā, f. sisterʼs daughter, niece.

स्वाकार 1. sva‿ākāra, m. own nature, 🞄natural disposition;
 2. su‿ākāra, a. having 🞄a respectable appearance.
स्वाकृति su‿ākṛti, a. good-looking, handsome, 🞄beautiful.
स्वागतीकृ svāgatī-kṛ, turn (their cries) 🞄into a welcome (peacocks).

स्वाचार su‿ācāra, m. good conduct (sts. pl.);
 🞄a. well conducted.
स्वाच्छन्द्य svācchand-ya, n. [sva-cCanda] 🞄independence, freedom: ab. voluntarily.
स्वाजन्य svājan-ya, n. [svajana] relationship.
स्वाजीव्य su‿ājīvya, a. affording an easy 🞄livelihood.
स्वाज्ञा sva‿ājñā, f. oneʼs command.
स्वातन्त्र्य svātantr-ya, n. [sva-tantra] independence, 🞄freedom of will: in. independently, 🞄by oneself.
स्वाति svātí (or ī́), the 13th (or 15th) lunar 🞄asterism.
स्वात्त svāttá, pp. √ svād.
स्वादान sva‿ādāna, n. taking oneʼs due.

स्वाधिकार sva‿adhikāra, m. own office, 🞄special charge;
 -adhiṣṭhāna, n. oneʼs own 🞄place.
स्वाधी su‿ādhī́, a. thoughtful, heedful, devout 🞄(RV.).
स्वानम su‿ānama, a. easy to attract (woman).
स्वापतेय svāpat-eya, n. [sva-pati] own property, 🞄wealth.
स्वापव्यसन svāpa-vyasana, n. excessive addiction 🞄to sleep, sloth.
स्वापि su‿āpí, m. good kinsman or comrade 🞄(V.): -mat a. containing the word svāpi (Br.).
स्वापिक svāpika, n. N. of a fortress.

स्वाप्त su‿āpta, pp. very abundant;
 very skilful 🞄or trusty.
स्वाप्यय sva‿apyayá, m. turning into oneself 🞄(as an explanation of svapna).
स्वाभाविक svābhāv-ika, a. (ī) belonging to 🞄oneʼs own nature, natural, original, peculiar, 🞄innate, inherent: -itara, a. not innate.
स्वाभाव्य svābhāv-ya, n. [sva-bhāva] peculiarity, 🞄naturalness.
स्वाम्य svāmya, n. [svāmin] ownership, lordship, 🞄dominion, power over any one.

स्वायत्त sva‿āyatta, pp. dependent on oneself, 🞄being in oneʼs own control: -tva, n. abst. ɴ.;
 🞄ī-kṛ, subject (ac.) to oneself.
स्वायस su‿āyasa, V. a. made of good metal 🞄(axe, knife).

स्वायुज् su‿āyúj, a. easy to yoke (RV.¹);
 🞄-āyudhá, a. well-armed (V.).
स्वारसिक svāras-ika, a. [sva-rasa] natural, 🞄self-evident.
स्वाराज्य svā́rājya, n. [sva-rāj] independent 🞄rule, uncontrolled sway.
स्वाराधित su‿ārādhita, pp. well conciliated, 🞄faithfully served (prince).

स्वारोचिष svārociṣ-a, m. [sva-rocis] pat. 🞄of the second Manu;
 a. relating to Manu 🞄Svārociṣa.
स्वार्जित sva‿arjita, pp. self-acquired.
स्वार्थिक svārth-ika, a. [sva‿artha] retaining 🞄(not modifying) the original meaning, pleonastic 🞄(suffix).
स्वार्द्र su‿ārdra, a. very wet.
स्वालक्षण्य svālakṣaṇ-ya, n. [svalakṣaṇa] 🞄specific characteristics, peculiar disposition.
स्वावश्य svāvaś-ya, n. [sva-vaśa] self-determination 🞄(Br.).

स्वावृज् su‿ā́vṛj, a. easy to acquire (RV.¹);
 🞄-āveśá, a. easy of access (V.).
स्वाशिषात्मन् sva‿āśiṣā‿ātman, a. thinking 🞄only of their own wishes [āśiṣā, in. of āśis].
स्वास्थ्य svāsth-ya, n. [sva-stha] sound state, 🞄health, ease.
स्वाहत sva‿āhata, pp. struck or coined by 🞄oneself.

स्वाहुत sú‿āhuta, pp. well sacrificed to (RV.);
 🞄-āhavāna, a. easy to invoke.
